thesisSummary: Northwind is a climate hardware fund writing $1-5M seed and Series A checks into energy storage, clean energy materials and devices (solar, hydrogen, electrification), and emissions sensing. It wants hardware that cuts storage cost or removes scarce minerals like lithium, cobalt and platinum, decarbonizes industrial heat and hydrogen, or continuously detects methane leaks. It backs working lab prototypes with measured data through field pilots, prefers exclusive licenses or patent-holding spinouts (field-of-use acceptable for materials), and excludes software, consumer, healthcare/life sciences, agriculture and buildings-only products.
